title: SO-2.08 Agent frameworks and runtimes: a provider-neutral task adapter and capability mapping
request: Closes G-SO-19. Source: the master traceability baseline of 31 October 2026 (section 8.4) and, where named, the Scope One addendum (PR #222, docs/scope-one/ADDENDUM-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DELIVERY-REVIEW.md at head a1757a0); 8.3 to 8.6 released for contracting by the owner on 31 Oct 2026. This contract is the design-record stage: it asks for the decision record and builds nothing. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository. The programme decomposition on branch docs/engine-decision-tiers-reconcile (docs/scope-one/programme/) is read for overlap: WP18-02 builds the SDK and the first framework adapter; this contract is every other framework and runtime and takes WP18-02 as its first instance, not as a competitor. Owner decision 31 Oct 2026: providers are neutral.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: Provider-neutral task adapter and capability mapping
The adapter layer must use canonical operation contracts. It must not let every provider create its own independent project state, permissions or acceptance model.
The rule for every integration is the same: Memev owns the operating model and authority; the specialist system remains responsible for its own specialised capability.
Keep provider-specific behaviour inside adapters; the planner and coordinator must consume capability declarations rather than provider-specific conditionals.
